cards.ex: Joining an online community helped me find people who share my passion for coding.
cards.exUz: Onlayn jamiyatga qo'shilish menga dasturlashga bo'lgan ishtiyoqni bo'lishadigan odamlarni topishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda umumiy qiziqishlari bor odamlarning guruhi.

cards.ex: Algorithm bias in facial recognition software can disproportionately affect certain demographics.
cards.exUz: Yuzni aniqlash dasturidagi algoritm xatoligi ayrim demografik guruhlarga nomutanosib ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

cards.ex: I'm planning a digital detox next weekend; no phone, no laptop.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta oxiri raqamli detoks qilishni rejalashtiryapman; na telefon, na noutbuk.

cards.ex: She's a successful content creator, making videos about sustainable living.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatli kontent yaratuvchi, barqaror hayot haqida videolar yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Onlaynda kontent (video, post, va boshqalar) yaratadigan shaxs.

cards.ex: That funny cat video has gone completely viral.
cards.exUz: O'sha kulgili mushuk videosi butunlay virusli bo'lib ketdi.

cards.ex: Social media can become an echo chamber where you only hear opinions you already agree with.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar siz allaqachon rozi bo'lgan fikrlarni eshitadigan aks-sado xonasiga aylanishi mumkin.

cards.ex: As a digital native, she understands the internet intuitively.
cards.exUz: Raqamli tubjoy sifatida u internetni intuitiv ravishda tushunadi.

cards.ex: I'm trying to reduce my screen time before bed.
cards.exUz: Yotishdan oldin ekran vaqtimni kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman.

cards.ex: Video conferencing suffers from bandwidth limitations in rural areas.
cards.exUz: Video konferensiya qishloq joylarda tarmoq cheklovlaridan aziyat chekadi.

cards.ex: Social networking can be a great way to find job opportunities.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ish imkoniyatlarini topishning ajoyib usuli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy aloqalarni onlayn o'rnatish va saqlash.

cards.ex: I use Twitter to stay informed about current events.
cards.exUz: Men Twitterdan hozirgi voqealar haqida xabardor bo'lish uchun foydalanaman.

cards.ex: The website went down for several hours yesterday.
cards.exUz: Veb-sayt kecha bir necha soat davomida ishlamay qoldi.

cards.ex: I had to power through the technical issues to finish the project.
cards.exUz: Loyihani tugatish uchun texnik muammolarni yengib o'tishim kerak edi.

cards.ex: Don't forget to plug into the charger before you leave.
cards.exUz: Ketishdan oldin zaryadlovchiga ulanishni unutmang.

cards.ex: The company is still using outdated technology, which slows down production.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya hali ham eski texnologiyadan foydalanmoqda, bu ishlab chiqarishni sekinlashtiradi.

cards.ex: Digital literacy is becoming increasingly important in the modern workplace.
cards.exUz: Raqamli savodxonlik zamonaviy ish joyida tobora muhim ahamiyat kasb etmoqda.

cards.ex: Make sure your website is mobile-friendly for users on smartphones.
cards.exUz: Smartfonlardagi foydalanuvchilar uchun veb-saytingiz mobilga mos bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qiling.

cards.ex: Data privacy is a major concern with the increasing use of technology.
cards.exUz: Texnologiyaning ortishi bilan ma'lumotlar maxfiyligi katta tashvish tug'dirmoqda.

cards.ex: The internet can lead to information overload, making it hard to focus.
cards.exUz: Internet haddan tashqari ko'p ma'lumotga olib kelishi mumkin, bu esa diqqatni jamlashni qiyinlashtiradi.

cards.ex: I like to browse the web for new recipes.
cards.exUz: Men yangi retseptlar uchun veb-saytlarni ko'rishni yoqtiraman.

cards.ex: The tech giant announced a new product launch.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya giganti yangi mahsulot ishga tushirilishini e'lon qildi.

cards.ex: We are living in the digital age, where everything is connected.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma narsa bog'langan raqamli davrda yashayapmiz.

cards.ex: Companies must be vigilant against cybersecurity threats.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar kiber xavfsizlik tahdidlariga qarshi hushyor bo'lishlari kerak.

cards.ex: I bought the dress from an online marketplace.
cards.exUz: Men ko'ylakni onlayn bozordan sotib oldim.

cards.ex: The app has a user-friendly interface, making it easy to navigate.
cards.exUz: Ilovada foydalanuvchi uchun qulay interfeys mavjud bo'lib, uni navigatsiya qilish oson.
cards.uzDef: Foydalanuvchi uchun oson va qulay interfeys.

cards.ex: Virtual reality is changing the way we play games and learn.
cards.exUz: Virtual reallik o'yin o'ynash va o'rganish usulini o'zgartirmoqda.

cards.ex: Augmented reality apps are becoming increasingly popular.
cards.exUz: Kengaytirilgan reallik ilovalari tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy dunyoni kompyuter grafikasi bilan birlashtirish.

cards.ex: Facebook is a popular social media platform.
cards.exUz: Facebook mashhur ijtimoiy tarmoq platformasidir.
cards.uzDef: Onlayn ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uchun veb-sayt yoki ilova.

cards.ex: The internet was a disruptive technology that changed everything.
cards.exUz: Internet hamma narsani o'zgartirgan buzuvchi texnologiya edi.

cards.ex: Some people worry that we're in another tech bubble.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar biz yana bir texnologiya pufagida ekanligimizdan xavotirda.
